headline: TRC (CONS) surges 31.25% on heavy volume, flagged by a 35.9σ volume spike and intraday move of +28.57%
market_take: Today's coverage shows strong buying in consumer and REIT stocks, led by TRC's 31.25% jump and MII's 10.53% rise. Property names are mixed, with KC down 33.33% and CGD up 11.11%. Several food stocks posted modest gains, while unusual‑trading alerts highlight heightened volatility in CHOTI, MJLF and other REITs.

sector_notes.note: TRC leads the sector with a 31.25% gain and 11.95x volume, supported by a 35.9σ volume spike. PLE opened with a +16.67% gap and APCS added +5.13% on low volume.

Property is split: KC fell 33.33% (vol×1.89) and PF dropped 20.00%, while CGD rose 11.11% and RICHY added 6.25%. GLAND faces a delisting notice for Sep 3‑11, and CMC reported a high‑priority connected transaction.
MII posted a 10.53% increase with 3.35x volume; multiple REITs (TIF1, MJLF, MNIT, QHBREIT, SPRIME) showed extreme volume spikes. Capital‑increase filings continue for PROSPECT and MII.
CHOTI experienced a 5.3σ volume spike. APURE and RBF posted gains of +6.31% and +5.77% respectively, while ITC disclosed AGM resolutions and KSL announced a new company secretary.
SMO announced completion of a capital restructuring of its subsidiary, and LEE reported a capital reduction after share repurchase cancellation.
